product_title: Elegant Rose Pearl Toran with Golden Accents
product_description: Enhance your entrance with this beautifully handcrafted toran, featuring vibrant pink roses, intricate golden detailing, sparkling embellishments, and graceful pearl swags with decorative tassels. Perfect for Diwali, weddings, pooja rooms, and festive home décor.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearls and floral embellishments with care.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
